summary: I developed a software for astronauts in space to assess their health through comparing metrics gathered from NASA website for the normal levels to the crew member's stats. It hits the core criteria of the challenge by addressing the need for astronauts to have a visualization of their health metrics and what they could do to maintain optimal health conditions. It is important because it provides ease in evaluating their health condition and keeps them several steps ahead to prevent any mishaps.
details: CrewMed takes the input (astronaut's health stats) provided to compare to normal levels of biochemical elements, and provides a visual representation of what needs to be addressed, which body system is at risk, treatment plan, level of risk, and why it needs to be addressed. I used Python on VSCode to develop the project. As of now, the inputs are in the form of adjustable sliders to simulate how the software would work if those numbers were the actual values. The program also compares the user's health metric to the levels of other crew members, as well as the group average. Furthermore, the program is tailored to the gender of the crew member to make the measurements more accurate and insightful. The program features a tracking pad for the menstrual cycle of the female crew member and provides warnings, suggestions, and keeps a log of specific changes, flow rates, abnormalities, etc. This feature is to address the discrepancy between male and female normal levels, and output data encompassing all body systems. The project is intended to hit all key points of health safety while the crew members are in space. So not only does it provide detailed overviews of each body system, vitamin levels, and outputs overall readiness score, it also makes it easy to understand. The crew member could choose to read the details, but they could also take a quick look at the charts and treatment plan animations to employ quick action. To make the program more engaging, it includes a ranking between all the crew members to gauge who has the best health metrics. It also provides badges tailored to each type of biochemical level or body system like video games award badges to players with most streak, most points, etc.
